description: Where a work item is in the flow, from filing to done. Position only: what stops an item is a hold (work_hold), and a hold never moves the position. How a programme shows each state (board column, label) is its own data: label-binding records that bind to these states.
name: work_item

states.description: Filed, but not yet judged unblocked, grounded and routed. Routines do not take it. A reopened item returns here.
states.label: Backlog

states.description: Unblocked, grounded and routed to a lane: one member may claim it. The routines' work queue.
states.label: Ready

states.description: Claimed by one member, who is working it. Nobody else starts it while the claim stands. A stop for a human's input keeps the claim and adds the needs-input hold.
states.label: In progress

states.description: A pull request that closes it is open. It is not claimable while that pull request is open, including while review asks for changes.
states.label: In review

states.description: Closed: completed (landed, or no code was needed) or not planned (dropped or superseded).
states.label: Done

transitions.description: Judged unblocked, grounded and routed. Any member may request it; the clerk makes it.
transitions.name: promote

transitions.description: One member claims it through the clerk.
transitions.name: claim

transitions.description: The owner's session or a group builder claims an item the feed never promoted.
transitions.name: claim-unfed

transitions.description: A pull request that closes it is open.
transitions.name: open-pr

transitions.description: The claim went quiet past the stale-claim window, with no open closing pull request and no needs-input hold.
transitions.name: reclaim

transitions.description: Its pull request closed without merging and no other is open.
transitions.name: pr-closed-unmerged

transitions.description: A merged pull request closed it.
transitions.name: merge

transitions.description: Closed by hand, not by a merged pull request: no code was needed, not planned, or superseded.
transitions.name: close-backlog

transitions.description: Closed by hand, not by a merged pull request: no code was needed, not planned, or superseded.
transitions.name: close-ready

transitions.description: Closed by hand, not by a merged pull request: no code was needed, not planned, or superseded.
transitions.name: close-in-progress

transitions.description: Closed by hand, not by a merged pull request: no code was needed, not planned, or superseded.
transitions.name: close-in-review

transitions.description: Reopened; it is judged again before it is fed.
transitions.name: reopen
